fields.name: TargetingPlayers
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x18A43C0 allocates 0x30 bytes; destructor is thunk to bg3.exe+0x582AD0 (the generic HashSet destructor). Toolkit ecl::ping::PingSystem::ProcessTargetingRequests (EoCClient.dll+0x695480) reads the singleton's key count at +0x2C and walks its keys at +0x20 with stride 2 (player ids, short), copying them into a system set. macOS: (anonymous)::IsInactiveInSplitscreenFullscreenTurn reads it. Live: empty.

second_pass: Confirmed on Windows: bg3.exe+0x18A2760 (PingSystem targeting step, called from the per-frame update bg3.exe+0x18A23E0) takes the singleton from 0x30-byte storage, copies its keys (+0x20, 2-byte stride, count +0x2C) into a system array and looks short ids up by (longlong)short % bucket count (+8) with 2-byte key compares - a HashSet<int16_t>.
open_questions: Key meaning (players currently in ping-targeting mode) inferred from LEGACY_RequestStartTarget(short const&)/LEGACY_RequestCancelTarget(short const&).
